options: The fundamental container every Fabric item — lakehouse, warehouse, report, pipeline — lives inside
A folder used only to organize items after they've already been deployed
A single Power BI report and nothing else
A synonym for a Microsoft Entra ID tenant
questions.explain: The workspace is Fabric's fundamental container and the real unit of deployment — every item lives inside exactly one workspace, which also determines who can see and edit it.

questions.q: What is the one real difference between the Contributor and Member workspace roles?
options: Member can manage some access (adding people at Member or below); Contributor cannot manage access at all
Contributor can delete the workspace; Member cannot
There is no difference — they are the same role with two names
Member is read-only; Contributor can edit content
questions.explain: Both Contributor and Member can create and edit content. The difference is access management: Member can add people at the Member role or below, while Contributor cannot touch the access list at all.

questions.q: Where do you go to see and change who currently has access to a workspace?
options: The Manage access panel, opened from the workspace header
The Domains page in the admin portal
The capacity settings page
A tenant setting's delegation controls
questions.explain: Selecting Manage access from the workspace header opens a panel listing current access and an Add people or groups button to grant more.

questions.q: Which workspace role is read-only — can view and interact with items like a published report, but cannot create or edit anything?
options: Viewer
Contributor
Member
Admin
questions.explain: Viewer is the narrowest role: read-only access to view and interact with items, with no ability to create or edit content.

questions.q: Besides its own set of workspace roles, what two other things is every Fabric workspace assigned to?
options: Exactly one capacity, and optionally one domain
Exactly one tenant setting and one sensitivity label
Two capacities, for redundancy
An admin portal page and a Git repository, always
questions.explain: A workspace is assigned to exactly one capacity (which pays for its compute and sets its region, from Lesson 2) and can be assigned to one domain (which groups it for discovery, from Lesson 4).
